paragraphs: I matriculated from High School Stellenberg in 2024 with IT, Engineering Graphics & Design, Maths and Physical Sciences. In 2025 I took a gap year: I improved my Maths and Physical Sciences results and worked three hands-on roles, repairing variable speed drives, roasting coffee and running facilities at my church.
Somewhere between a returns registry and a coffee roaster, I found software engineering. Now I build websites full-time, study part-time, and build my own products after hours.

bullets: Build and customise client websites in WordPress with the team, writing custom code where themes fall short.

Set up and manage client DNS records, and design assets in Illustrator, Figma and Canva.
Work directly with clients, from first brief through to launch.

roles.text: My product studio, where I design and build SaaS apps. First up: Budget Tracker, a mobile budgeting app on React Native and Spring Boot.
Handled sales, roasting, packaging and deliveries, and learnt first-hand how a small business runs.
Tested and repaired variable speed drives, wrote client reports, and pitched and built a new returns system for the branch.
Managed the youth database, ran inventory and event logistics, and did general maintenance.
